title: Coty reports rocky start to 2027 fiscal year as Middle East war bites revenues
summary: Coty, the owner of Kylie Cosmetics, has called 2027 a ‘transitional year’, as it grapples with the loss of Gucci and shores up other areas of its business with a 40-year extension of its Marc Jacobs Beauty license
